{#- Version switcher for the Furo sidebar, populated by sphinx-polyversion. conf.py's load() puts two values into html_context (and therefore into the template namespace): * current -- the GitRef of the version being rendered * revisions -- all built versions (GitRef namedtuples: .name, .date, ...) Both are absent on a plain `make html` build, so nothing is rendered then. Every version lives in a sibling directory of the site root (//...). `pathto('index')` is the relative path from the current page to *this* version's index.html; stripping the trailing "index.html" yields the path to this version's root, from which "..//" reaches any other version. This is correct at any nesting depth. -#} {%- if revisions %} {#- pathto('index') is the relative path to this version's index.html, EXCEPT on the index page itself where Sphinx returns the self-anchor '#'; treat that as root. -#} {%- set _p = pathto('index') %} {%- set vroot = '' if _p == '#' else _p | replace('index.html', '') %}

Versions

{%- endif %}
